gaps.area: Limited personal real-use authorization and runtime evidence
gaps.why_first: It is the smallest missing boundary between the fixed, non-sensitive, task-local candidate and actual self-use. It also begins producing the real workflow and user-value evidence that later hard gates depend on.
gaps.existing_basis: P3-097/P3-098 establish a fixed CLI/local completion-point candidate under single-process, offline, task-local, non-sensitive fixtures.
gaps.missing: Explicit user confirmation for exact data class, new dedicated self-use directory/DB, user-entered content, allowed CLI entry points, cleanup, failure stop rules and evidence.
gaps.reason_tauri_not_required: The next minimum slice can remain CLI-only with Tauri/IPC, Vault, export, network, cloud and external capabilities disabled.

gaps.area: Basic permission settings on an actual data flow
gaps.dependency: Depends on a separately authorized real-use data flow; controlled grant/deny/revoke evidence already exists.
Depends on an authorized real-use DB/path and must retain R-0019 fail-closed semantics.
Requires separate real file/path authorization and may trigger R-0040 if implemented through Tauri/IPC; it is not part of the first CLI-only enablement slice.

gaps.area: Alpha instructions and Gate 5 value evidence
gaps.dependency: Instructions must align to actually enabled behavior; Gate 5 evidence requires real self-use or Alpha behavior and counterevidence.
Required only when a chosen entry point uses Tauri capability/IPC/WebView/platform path behavior. The selected minimum next slice does not.
